Transparent 50/50 Milestone Escrow (USD $)

Why Students Never Pay 100% Upfront

Unlike generic writing sites that demand full payment before you see a single line of work, DSMS splits every quotation into two equal milestones held securely in escrow.

Milestone 1: 50% Advance
Starts Work

Initiates work immediately. Academic specialist begins researching, compiling code, creating simulation diagrams, and drafting clean sheets.

Milestone 2: 50% Balance
Unlocks File

Paid strictly after the document is finalized and you inspect the watermarked preview. Decryption token is released instantly.

Complete Peace-of-Mind Guarantee
  • •All source codes verified in genuine Linux/Windows terminal environments
  • •Strict on-time commitment: Missed agreed deadline triggers full advance refund
  • •Two complimentary revision rounds included within 7 days of final delivery

Our 4-Point Student Guarantee

Every submission through DSMS is protected by our academic quality charter.

Strict Deadline Commitment

If a deliverable is delivered past the agreed deadline without prior mutual consent, you receive a full refund of your 50% advance.

Zero AI-Hallucinated Code

All algorithms, Wireshark traces, and Packet Tracer configs are verified in real compiler environments with screenshots.

Complimentary Revision Policy

Every task includes up to 2 free revision rounds within 7 days of delivery for teacher feedback or rubric adjustments.

Confidentiality & Data Privacy

We never publish your university papers online. Your student identity, registration number, and contact info are 100% encrypted.
